note: Rejudged 2026-10-23 by an independent auditor (not the author) after 010e649057, which sends a synthesized withdrawal only to a destination holding an adj-out record for the route; RFC 4271 Section 3.1 allows a withdrawal only for "the IP prefix that expresses the destination for a previously advertised route". The owner approved re-fixturing these .ci (RFC-approved trailers in 010e649057). RFC 1997, Well-known Communities, NO_ADVERTISE (0xFFFFFF02): "All routes received carrying a communities attribute containing this value MUST NOT be advertised to other BGP peers." Moved unit: test/plugin/wellknown-no-advertise-egress.ci (both tags). Neither session now expects 180A0100 withdrawn; both reject 180A0100 in the announced AND withdrawn scopes, since neither was ever advertised it. Non-vacuity: the internal session must receive 180A0200 (NO_EXPORT_SUBCONFED allows an internal peer) and the 192.0.2.0/24 fence; the external session must receive the fence; plugin16WellknownCounts now demands exact counts 2 internal and 1 external. A gate that leaks to either peer type fails the announced reject; a forward-nothing build fails the fence deliveries. The wireu predicate pair (TestWellKnownNoAdvertiseRefusesEveryPeer / AbsentAdvertisesToEveryPeer) and TestForwardNoAdvertiseSkipsEveryPeer are byte-identical. The prior note's 'withdrawn at BOTH destinations' is superseded: the route is now neither announced nor withdrawn, which is what RFC 4271 Section 3.1 permits for a never-advertised route.
